identity_scope: Wingless research optimizer only. No FORGE, CKB-plane, KTRADE, K-Terminal, or workstation.
original_T40_summary: Compositional public-trained predictions beat strong controls under structured priors, but under unrestricted laws Brier 0.265-0.349 vs uniform 0.25; native performance unproven.
question: Can a model choose between a compositional and unrestricted causal-law prior from public TRAIN evidence alone, preserving forecast gains under structured mechanisms without suffering systematic unrestricted-law miscalibration?
hypothesis: A public-TRAIN-heldout marginal-likelihood selector over a factorized compositional law prior versus an unrestricted uniform 256-rule prior may learn when exact compositional constraints are informative. The selector never alters the independently exact all-256 hard-certification standard.

candidate.fit: Given 64 public TRAIN trajectories per source-free regime, first 48 fit an S3-free 768 program-factorization model using exactly three EM sweeps; on a disjoint 16 held-out TRAIN trajectories infer a scalar mixture weight selected from the fixed grid [0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1] by joint-signature log likelihood; refit factorized model on all 64 public TRAIN trajectories for forecast use.
candidate.priors: Composition prior over all 16x16x3 causal programs; unrestricted prior over all 256 truth tables. No private regime, law, or identity labels available to candidate.
candidate.prediction: Condition learned mixture over all public-TRAIN-consistent 256 laws; forecast unobserved bits only. Never infer that a distributional score licenses hard certification.
candidate.exact_guard: Independent exact all-256 legal-law version space; only observed bits or logical entailment can be hard certified. No confidence-to-proof conversion.
candidate.safety_on_unsupported_training: Trained selection must be empirically demonstrated; an unrestricted prior that is merely hard-coded as a fallback is not accepted as learned cognition.

sourcefree_custody.G_H_gate_coverage: all 16 input-output gates independently guaranteed in G and H public TRAIN program-origin identities for compositional families, but identity only visible to generation auditor
sourcefree_custody.out_of_class_control: unrestricted 256, including 64 Boolean functions not realizable by specified compositional grammar

fair_controls: Untrained fixed mixture 0.5 composition / unrestricted as selection ablation
TRAIN-fitting selector only, source-identity-labeled oracle excluded from eligible controls

prereg_acceptance.correct_hard_certifications: zero hard false certifications under all 256 laws
prereg_acceptance.risk: No >0.01 mean Brier regression vs uniform 0.25 on unrestricted, across 2/4/6 public masks. Structured regimes require lower Brier than best equally TRAIN-fitted comparator across each public mask budget to claim superiority.
prereg_acceptance.causal_ablation: TRAIN-fitted selector must demonstrably change weights or forecasts compared to fixed 0.5 mixture; no selection inferred from test labels.
prereg_acceptance.complete_cost: Five fresh whole-process trials per arm on both GitHub-hosted Windows and Linux. Include all sourcefree TRAIN creation, fitting, heldout selection, eval construction, exact verification, and prediction.
prereg_acceptance.native_admission: No complete CPU regression and no peak-RSS regression against strongest eligible equally trained comparator, zero correctness regression, and measured query-service parity; else do not advance to original scientific first use.
prereg_acceptance.unknown_service_cost: UNMEASURED => scientific and optimizer adoption remain false.
prereg_acceptance.preserve_failure: Do not modify thresholds after evaluation, reuse consumed sourcefree eval, or relabel mathematical feasibility as scientific transfer.
prereg_acceptance.scope: Source-free internal feasibility; even full gate pass only warrants proposing separate independently authenticated new causal source-family first use.

execution: freeze -> new sourcefree generator commit -> candidate+controls commit -> sourcefree property checks before evaluation -> exactly one Windows/Linux GH-hosted comparison -> seal original hashes and positive/negative evidence
